mapper.select: INSERT INTO iam_identities (normalized_email, display_name, created_at) VALUES (#{row.normalizedEmail}, #{row.displayName}, #{row.createdAt}) RETURNING id, normalized_email, display_name, created_at

INSERT INTO iam_credentials (identity_id, credential_type, password_hash, issued_at, expires_at, invalidated_at) VALUES (#{row.identityId}, #{row.credentialType}, #{row.passwordHash}, #{row.issuedAt}, #{row.expiresAt}, #{row.invalidatedAt}) RETURNING id, identity_id, credential_type, password_hash, issued_at, expires_at, invalidated_at
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM iam_credentials WHERE identity_id = #{identityId} AND credential_type = 'PASSWORD' AND invalidated_at IS NULL ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
SELECT id, identity_id, credential_type, password_hash, issued_at, expires_at, invalidated_at FROM iam_credentials WHERE identity_id = #{identityId} ORDER BY issued_at, id
